title: Nirogi Lanka Open Multilingual Clinical Calculators & Standardized Adult Laboratory Reference Dataset (2026)
description: Open-access, physician-reviewed dataset of 25 core adult hematology, metabolic, renal, thyroid, hepatic, and cardiovascular laboratory reference intervals (conventional and SI units) paired with validated clinical calculator equations (CKD-EPI 2021 race-free eGFR, ADAG HbA1c-to-eAG, Mifflin-St Jeor BMR, WHO/Asian BMI risk cutoffs) across 21 languages.
